subject: Notice of Civil Hearing – Case CV-2026-04178
body:
NOTICE OF CIVIL HEARING

Case Number: CV-2026-04178
Court: Superior Court of California, County of Alameda, Department 17
Case Type: Civil — Small Claims

Dear Respondent,

You are hereby notified that a hearing in the above-referenced civil matter has been scheduled as follows:

Date: Wednesday, June 3, 2026
Time: 9:30 AM
Location: René C. Davidson Courthouse, 1225 Fallon Street, Oakland, CA 94612, Department 17

You are required to appear at this hearing in person. If you fail to appear, the court may enter a default judgment against you without further notice.

Please bring all documentation, contracts, receipts, photographs, and any other evidence supporting your position. You may also bring witnesses who have direct knowledge of the facts in dispute.

If you require a continuance of the hearing date, you must file a written request with the clerk's office at least ten (10) court days before the scheduled hearing date. Continuances are granted at the court's discretion and are not automatic.

For case information or to request forms, contact the Civil Division at (510) 891-6012, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM.

Office of the Clerk
Superior Court of California, County of Alameda
